{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure we start fresh and have the corrected 'revenue' column
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from 'loyal' customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any such orders exist
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
